name: streamingSpreadsheetProcess
description: Reads a sheet with streaming and calls a function for each row. Returns the processed streaming spreadsheet object.

params.name: source
params.description: File path of the spreadsheet to read.

params.name: options
params.description: Struct of options. Keys: sheetName, async, randomAccessWindowSize.

params.name: rowProcessor
params.description: Function called for each row. It receives the spreadsheet object and the row number, and must return the spreadsheet object.
